global_must: Do not invent numeric thresholds, material subclasses, benchmarks, or user preferences absent from the input.
Do not convert ambiguity or explicit unknowns into confirmed positive constraints.
Do not use candidate_values as a place for domain-guessed values.
Do not create hard filters from soft preferences or ambiguous conditions.
downstream_search_terms must contain no CJK characters and no explanatory prose.
risk_flags must never act as exclusion rules.

must: Interpret long-term stability in battery context without inventing a cycle-count threshold.
Represent electrolyte system as explicitly unrestricted, not as a missing electrolyte choice.
Do not add salt, solvent, NMC, solid-state, or other unmentioned chemistry.
Interpret long-term stability in agent/continuous-operation context without battery terminology.
Represent model architecture as explicitly unrestricted.
Do not invent uptime, benchmark, model family, or latency thresholds.
Preserve 4.2 V as an explicit observed value but do not assign upper/lower/cutoff direction.
Require confirmation if direction materially affects filtering.
Do not emit a hard voltage filter.
Preserve both user-stated temperature constraints.
Flag the conflict and require review before applying mutually incompatible hard filters.
Do not silently choose one constraint or average the values.
Treat unknown charge rate as missing information, not as a guessed fast/slow rate constraint.
Treat cathode material system as explicitly unrestricted and prevent positive material filtering.
Do not invent C-rate values or cathode chemistries.
Preserve the explicit >= 1 mS/cm meaning.
An exactly equivalent 1e-3 S/cm notation may be used, but no different threshold may be introduced.
Represent chemistry as explicitly unrestricted and do not add sulfide/oxide/polymer preference.
Preserve <= 200 ms as a user-stated soft preference, not a hard exclusion filter.
Represent model type as explicitly unrestricted.
Do not invent a benchmark, architecture, provider, or stricter latency target.
Represent recency as a source preference.
Do not convert five years into an exclusion rule because the user explicitly allows classic older papers.
Keep classic-paper allowance visible to downstream filtering.
